loadEnvelopeBasis: Retained 3 A stress envelope on both converters. Accepted provisional design loads are 1 A VCCL and 3 A VDD. The accepted load file is simulations/power-dynamics/provisional-loads.json. The PDX reference supply sizing informs these loads. Neither the design loads nor this stress envelope are verified chip-current maxima. VDD uses the full nominal regulator rating. Thermal and transient qualification remain open.

capacitorTraceLimits.note: Explicit local limits replace the generic 1 mm automatic decoupling limit. The emitted-copper audit separately enforces the shorter VIN, VOS, SW and feedback budgets.

qualification.note: Trace-segment resistance uses 35 um copper and a 60 C rise from 20 C. It excludes pad/package spreading, global planes, ground return and component losses. Local pours provide parallel paths. These project budgets are not separate ASMedia or TI numerical requirements.
